scope: Randomized variants of the weapons whose chance on hit Go registers through itemhelpers.CreateWeaponProcSpell and CreateWeaponProcAura (Barbaric Crossbow, Plaguefang, Wolfsbane, Venomstrike, Stinging Viper, Alcor's Sunrazor, Bloodfist, Bonechill Hammer, Darrowspike, Coldrage Dagger, Glacial Blade, Flame Wrath, Masterwork Stormhammer, Electrified Dagger, Shadowstrike, The Cruel Hand of Timmy, Skullforge Reaver, Flurry Axe, The Lobotomizer, Ebon Hilt of Marduk, Sword of Zeal and Argent Avenger) and of Annihilator's armor debuff, each worn in the main hand, the off hand or the ranged slot of the classes that wield it: 107 weapon and class pairs on Fury, Arms and Protection Warriors, Combat Rogues, Protection and Retribution Paladins, Enhancement Shamans and Survival and Marksmanship Hunters, against 1 to 5 targets, plus the 18 accepted weapon proc fixtures. 586 variants of 125 requests at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. Each variant draws its race from the races of its class.
generator: python3 tools/weapon_proc_sweep.py --output <scratch>, which draws the variants of tools/sweep.py (seed 20261008 plus the row's position, 200 iterations, melee range for every request but the Hunter's ranged slot) from the accepted production requests with each weapon equipped, 4 to 8 variants of each; each variant <scratch>/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json is compared as variants/NAME-sweep-NN.request.json

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log. 467 of the 513 variants that keep a weapon show its proc in the first fight: its spell cast, or for Annihilator, Sword of Zeal and Argent Avenger the aura gained.

The variants lower talents, drop buffs, debuffs, consumables and gear (a weapon too, in about a seventh of them) and change the target level, distance, reaction time and random stream mode. The rows cover a direct hit on the melee, ranged and magic tables, a travelling bolt, a chain, an area hit, a damage over time alone and beside a hit, a hit with a heal Go does not simulate, an extra attack, an armor debuff, an aura of physical damage and attack power, and a dot that rolls its application, in the main hand, the off hand and the ranged slot, against 1 to 5 targets and on a tank.
